nodes.label: Track
nodes.rationale: A single audio file (mp3, flac, wav, ogg, m4a, aac) on disk that derpy can play. Avoid: Song, file.

nodes.label: Earmark
nodes.rationale: A user-flagged Track that 'hit right' in the moment. Expires after 30 days. Encrypted, uploaded to Blossom, and recorded in a private Nostr list that follows the user's identity across devices. Avoid: Favourite, bookmark, like.

nodes.label: Tag (derpy)
nodes.rationale: A free-form, lowercase, user-authored string label attached to a Track for search/filter. Permanent (no expiry). Stored in a derpy-local index keyed by the Track's Sum, never written into the audio file itself. Avoid: Label, keyword, genre.

nodes.label: Sum
nodes.rationale: The metadata-invariant fingerprint of a Track's audio data, computed via dhowden/tag's Sum function (SHA-1 of audio bytes, skipping ID3/MP4/FLAC metadata blocks per-format). Used as the primary key for the Tag index. Survives renames and embedded-metadata edits, but not re-encoding. Avoid: Hash, fingerprint, checksum.

nodes.label: Sum cache
nodes.rationale: The mtime+size-validated path->Sum mapping at ~/.config/derpy/sum-cache.json. Bridges the file-system view (paths) and the Tag index (Sums). Populated lazily by the background indexer.

nodes.label: Tag index
nodes.rationale: The Sum->[Tag,...] mapping at ~/.config/derpy/tags.json. Source of truth for what Tags a Track has.

nodes.label: NIP-44 Encryption
nodes.rationale: Earmarks use NIP-44 encryption so relays see only ciphertext; only the key holder can read the earmark list. Part of the privacy-first design.

nodes.label: 30-Day Earmark Expiry
nodes.rationale: Earmarks expire after 30 days — intentional design to capture what's resonating right now rather than building a permanent archive. Forces continued discovery.
